# Copilot Instructions for BindProteina

**Purpose:** short, actionable guide so an AI coding agent can be immediately productive in this repository.

- **Big Picture:** BindProteina is a LaProteina-based binder evolution pipeline that (1) generates candidate binders, (2) scores them with AF2-Multimer + PyRosetta, then (3) iteratively evolves top designs. See [BindProteina/README.md](BindProteina/README.md#L1) for the full overview.

- **Key directories:**
  - **BindProteina/laproteina/**: core generation/evolution logic.
  - **BindProteina/visualizer/**: dashboard backend/frontend (see server and frontend files referenced in README).
  - **BindProteina/designer/**: Streamlit app to create `settings_target` JSONs; run example: `streamlit run designer/app.py` — see [BindProteina/designer/app.py](BindProteina/designer/app.py#L1-L120).
  - **BindProteina/params, /checkpoint, /settings_evolution/**: configuration, AF2 weights and example settings.

- **Environment & install:**
  - Create the Conda env with: `conda env create -f environment.yml` then `conda activate <env-name>` (or use `bash install.sh --pkg_manager conda --cuda 12.6`). See [BindProteina/environment.yml](BindProteina/environment.yml#L1).
  - The provided `install.sh` creates two environments (main `BindProteina` and `protenix_env`) to avoid NumPy conflicts; prefer using the script for consistent, tested package versions. See [BindProteina/install.sh](BindProteina/install.sh#L1).

- **Common workflows & commands:**
  - Run an evolution run: `python laproteina/proteinfoundation/evolve.py --settings settings_evolution/CLD18.json` (settings files live in `settings_evolution/`).
  - Score an existing run: `python laproteina_scoring/score.py --input_dir ./my_designs --output_dir ./scoring_results --settings ./settings_target/PDL1.json`.
  - Start the visualizer backend: `python visualizer/backend/server.py --evolution-dir ./evolution_output` and open `visualizer/frontend/index.html`.

- **Repository conventions & patterns:**
  - Settings-first design: long-running experiments use JSON settings under `settings_evolution/` or `settings_target/`; command-line args override JSON values.
  - YAML + Hydra-style configs are common across components; prefer reading defaults via provided `get_defaults()` helpers (see `designer/settings/templates.py`).
  - Checkpoints & model artifacts: stored under `params/` or `checkpoints_laproteina/`; code expects full paths in settings JSON.

- **Streamlit designer notes (practical gotchas):**
  - The Streamlit app expects to be run from repository root so imports and path translators work correctly. If you see `KeyError: 'folding_model'` it means defaults returned by `get_defaults()` are missing a key — check [BindProteina/designer/app.py](BindProteina/designer/app.py#L1-L120) where defaults are read and session-state keys are set.
  - When editing settings generated by the designer, validate JSON keys against example templates in `settings_evolution/template.json`.

- **Integration points & external deps:**
  - AlphaFold2/ColabDesign integration is used for folding predictions; AF2 weights and model files live in `params/` and are installed/managed by `install.sh`.
  - PyRosetta is used for relaxation & interface metrics — CPU/GPU and license requirements must be respected in CI/cluster runs.
  - Protenix is installed into a separate environment (`protenix_env`) to avoid runtime conflicts — do not install Protenix into the main `BindProteina` env.

- **Testing & debugging tips:**
  - Small, local smoke tests: run single-step scripts with reduced settings (e.g., `rounds: 1`, `top_n: 1`) to validate end-to-end behavior before launching SLURM jobs.
  - For Streamlit problems, run from repo root and ensure `st.session_state` defaults exist (see `get_defaults()` and `_STATE_DEFAULTS` in [designer/app.py](BindProteina/designer/app.py#L1-L120)).

- **Files to reference when editing behavior:**
  - Pipeline entrypoints: `laproteina/proteinfoundation/evolve.py` and `laproteina_scoring/score.py`.
  - Designer: [BindProteina/designer/app.py](BindProteina/designer/app.py#L1-L120) and `designer/settings/*`.
  - Install & env: [BindProteina/install.sh](BindProteina/install.sh#L1) and [BindProteina/environment.yml](BindProteina/environment.yml#L1).

If anything above is unclear or you'd like the instructions expanded with specific code examples or additional file links (for example, exact lines to change for a common fix), tell me which area to expand. I'll iterate quickly.
